sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: A tiny fox-faced bat perches nearby with its wings folded like a cloak and eyes much too clever for something pretending not to understand cards.

sections.title: Public role
sections.body: Small companion creature connected to Halython Fives

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: A tiny russet fox-bat with huge ears, folded wings like a cloak, clever paws, and bright eyes that make Halython's card table feel watched by something playful.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as a warmth-and-specificity cue. It can point to a clue, soften Halython, or give nervous players a harmless living detail to engage.
